# testing_import_id_integer (Resource)

ImportIDInteger Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_import_id_integer" "my_importidinteger" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_import_id_integer.my_testing_import_id_integer
  id = 0
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_import_id_integer.my_testing_import_id_integer 0
```
